text:
The plate is square, roughly 26 cm across at its widest, so I treated it as a dinner plate. The asparagus pile is about 14 cm long and 6 cm wide, only 1 to 1.5 cm high, and made up of thin spears. I counted about 10 to 12 spears, and at roughly 8 g each that comes to about 70 g. There are a few tiny crumbs, which I ignored. There is no visible oil or sauce.
